description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lonis.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
